name: Time Select
summary: A choice of time of day, as a native <select>. The option list is the platform's own, so the reader gets the system's own picker and its keyboard behaviour; the library draws the field and the arrow around it.
summaryZh: 从若干时刻里挑一个,用的是原生 <select>。选项列表是平台自己的,所以读者拿到的是系统自带的弹层和键盘行为;库只画外面的框和那个箭头。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The field carries a hairline border. The base class on its own is this field, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Filled
variants.note: The border goes away and the field sits on a recessed surface, so the field reads as a well rather than as a box.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's small control height and the option text takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default field. The base class is already this height, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The field follows the theme's large control height.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the field, because the field is what the reader is on.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field paints a flat surface and takes the derived disabled colour, so the chosen time stays readable.

parts.name: Select
parts.note: The real <select>, borderless inside the field. It drops the platform's arrow, because that arrow does not follow the theme; the option list is still the platform's.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One time in the list. It is the platform's own option, so the popup it belongs to is the reader's.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The chevron that says the field opens a list. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen time. It is the select's own value — a class cannot carry a time.
props.descriptionZh: 选中的时刻。它是 select 自己的值 —— 类带不了时刻。

props.name: start
props.description: The first time in the list. The list is the host's data: a class cannot carry the times either.
props.descriptionZh: 列表里的第一个时刻。列表是宿主的数据:类同样带不了这些时刻。

props.name: end
props.description: The last time in the list.
props.descriptionZh: 列表里的最后一个时刻。

props.name: step
props.description: How far apart the times are, in seconds. Half an hour is the default; an hour is 3600.
props.descriptionZh: 两个时刻之间隔多少秒。默认是半小时;一小时是 3600。

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field. It becomes the select's aria-label, because the library does not draw a label of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 字段的可访问名称。它会变成 select 的 aria-label,因为库自己不画标签。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让字段不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: variant
props.description: The surface of the field. The bordered run is the base class on its own; the filled run adds um-time-select--filled.
props.descriptionZh: 字段的底面。描边这一跑就是只写基础类;填充这一跑再加上 um-time-select--filled。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The chosen time, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `value` prop is the chosen time; bind it and the field answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 选中的时刻,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 value 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when a time is chosen. It is the browser's own event on the select — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 选定一个时刻时触发。这是 select 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

a11y.notes: The control is a real <select>, so the browser announces it as a combobox, the arrow keys walk the options and the reader's own popup opens it. Give it a real <label for> or an aria-label. The chevron beside it is drawn from two borders and carries no text — it says there is a list, and the browser says what is in it.
a11y.notesZh: 控件是一个真正的 <select>,所以浏览器会把它播报成组合框,方向键可以在选项之间走,读者自己的弹层也会由它打开。给它一个真正的 <label for> 或 aria-label。它旁边那个箭头是用两条边框画出来的,自己不带文字 —— 它说明这里有一个列表,而列表里有什么是浏览器说的。

examples.title: Half-hour steps
examples.description: A select of half-hourly times. The platform's arrow is gone and the library draws its own, because the platform's arrow does not follow the theme; the list that opens is still the platform's.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个半小时一档的选择器。平台自带的箭头被去掉了,库画了自己的,因为平台的箭头不跟主题走;弹出来的列表仍然是平台的。

examples.title: Filled
examples.description: The same field with the border gone and a recessed surface under it. Only the modifier class changes.
examples.descriptionZh: 同一个字段,描边去掉,底下换成一层凹陷的面。只改修饰类。

examples.title: States
examples.description: A disabled field. It leaves the tab order, and the chosen time stays on screen so the reader can still read it.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个禁用的字段。它退出 Tab 顺序,选中的时刻还留在屏幕上,读者仍然读得到。

notes: The times in the list are the host's data, not the library's: a class cannot carry half an hour, so the granularity is written into the markup as the options themselves. What the library draws is the field and the chevron — the platform's arrow is dropped because it does not follow the theme, while the option list is left exactly as the platform draws it, because a popup the reader already knows is worth more than one painted in the mood's colours.
notesZh: 列表里的时刻是宿主的数据,不是库的:类带不了半小时,所以粒度是写进标记里的那些选项本身。库画的是外面这个框和那个箭头 —— 平台自带的箭头被去掉,因为它不跟主题走;而选项列表原样留给平台来画,因为读者本来就熟悉的弹层,比一个用 mood 的颜色画出来的弹层更值钱。
